snippet.title: Remnants Of Nightfall  - Trailer
snippet.description:
This project is in development phase: Feel free to test and give feedback ;) 

A outbreak just started! 

A small town needs to protected themselves and wait for rescue to come. 

Infecteds are all over the place! There is hope: they can't resist the daylight, but they can thrive at night. 

Remnants Of Nightfall is a strategy-shooter tower-defense in development.
